Who will be the next Chief Minister of Bihar — Nitish Kumar, Tejashwi Yadav, Samrat Choudhary, Prashant Kishor, or someone else? The answers will unfold in the Bihar Assembly Elections 2025.
Before that, The Lallantop went on the ground to capture the real mood of Bihar. In our series, “Hum Bihar Ke Log”, we spend a day with people from diverse backgrounds to understand their lives, dreams, and challenges.
